# Write or revise the skill

Given Requirements, Skill identity, Destination, project instructions, Standard, Design, and any Findings, write the skill files or revise the existing candidate to resolve the findings.

Write SKILL.md with standard skill frontmatter, the workflow marker, and the Mermaid graph first. Add only useful Notes bullets afterward. Write each referenced instruction file with its purpose, explicit required inputs, actions, and returned outputs. Put Inputs bullets in the start file and Outputs bullets in the stop file. Use relative Markdown paths and the requested control shapes; follow Standard for any subagent annotations, fork pairing, or nested workflows.

Return Candidate identifying every written file, alongside Requirements, Skill identity, Destination, project instructions, Standard, and Design.
